sources.label: Minimal Morphe patch to disable left swipes on Pupil gallery cards
sources.author: rikunode Pupil
patch_list: Stop Pupil 6.1.1 checking for updates at startup and showing update prompts. Manual update checking in Settings remains available.
Disable the left-swipe action tray on Pupil 6.1.1 gallery cards. Preserve taps, long taps, reader gestures and vertical scrolling.
Show a one-tap random gallery button above the bottom navigation on the Favorites tab in Pupil 6.1.1.
